name: Circuit Zandvoort
description: Among the dunes on the Dutch coast. Narrow and twisty, with steeply banked corners at Hugenholtz and onto the main straight.
direction_note: Points are ordered in race direction. Index 0 is the start/finish line.
raceline_source: modules/tracks/tools/raceline.py (minimum lap time, GT3 point-mass model)

elevation.source: Terrarium elevation tiles, AWS Open Data (SRTM, USGS 3DEP, national lidar), smoothed

barriers.source: OpenStreetMap barriers (1520 of 1728 edge points mapped) and gravel areas, defaults by corner and circuit style elsewhere
